description:
Create a new Activity log in farmOS Field Kit with the following details:

1. Log Name: 'Subsoiling - Field 4'
2. Date: August 15, 2025
3. Notes: 'Ran Yeomans Keyline Plow to alleviate plow pan compaction. 3 shanks on 30-inch centers. Soil conditions were dry enough for excellent shattering. No subsoil mixing observed. Followed keyline contour pattern.'
4. Add a Quantity: 4.5 acres (Label: Area Treated)
5. Add a SECOND Quantity: 16 inches (Label: Working Depth)

Ensure the log type is set to 'Activity'. Save the log when finished.
